	right customer at the right time, and actively deflecting incoming support tickets.</h3> <h3 class="subtitle is-5">We also use data to help you constantly improve your product <em>and</em> your docs, leaving

	within your product.</p> <p class="subtitle is-6">No more sending users off-site, waiting for support staff, or getting nowhere with chatbots.
</p> <p class="subtitle is-6">Just the right help, for the right person, at the right time</p> <a class="button is-outlined is-expanded-mobile" href="https://elev.io/product/contextual-support">More on the Assistant</a></div></div></div></section> <section class="section is-medium"><div class="container"><div class="columns level is-centered"><div class="column is-4"><h3 class="title is-3 is-size-4-mobile is-spaced">Guide Users with Hotspots</h3> <p class="subtitle is-6">Positioned anywhere on your page, Hotspots provide instant prompts to inline help.</p> <p class="subtitle is-6">Set them up to disappear after use, or have them stay permanently, it's up to you.</p> <p class="subtitle is-6">No developers required 🎉</p> <a class="button is-outlined is-expanded-mobile" href="https://elev.io/product/hotspots">More on Hotspots</a></div> <div class="column is-5 is-offset-1 is-hidden-mobile"><figure class="image"><img class="js-lazy-image" data-src="https://elev.io/img/asset_helper.png"/></figure></div></div></div></section> <section class="section is-medium"><div class="container"><div class="columns level is-centered"><div class="column is-5 is-hidden-mobile"><figure class="image"><img class="js-lazy-image" data-src="https://elev.io/img/referral/answerassist@2x.png"/></figure></div> <div class="column is-4 is-offset-1"><h3 class="title is-3 is-size-4-mobile is-spaced">Reduce Your Support Loads</h3> <p class="subtitle is-6">We also intelligently surface relevant content right before your customers submit support
	tickets, to instantly resolve issues and actively deflect 20% of customer tickets on average.</p></div></div></div></section> <section class="section is-medium"><div class="container"><div class="columns level is-centered"><div class="column is-4"><h3 class="title is-3 is-size-4-mobile is-spaced">Measure the Impact</h3> <p class="subtitle is-6">Dive into reports and see how your users are engaging with your in-app help.</p></div> <div class="column is-5 is-offset-1 is-hidden-mobile"><figure class="image"><img class="js-lazy-image" data-src="https://elev.io/img/referral/reporting@2x.png"/></figure></div></div></div></section> <section class="section is-medium"><div class="container"><div class="columns level is-centered"><div class="column is-5 is-hidden-mobile"><figure class="image"><img class="js-lazy-image" data-src="https://elev.io/images/hub-advisor@2x.png"/></figure></div> <div class="column is-4 is-offset-1"><h3 class="title is-3 is-size-4-mobile is-spaced">Improve Your Docs, Proactively</h3> <p class="subtitle is-6">Advisor uses Machine Learning to help you to continuously improve your docs based on engagement
